coverage_notes.source_review: Focused results were old cases, future reopening plans without operational restoration, international events, or previously noted closures. September 2026 Tehama County air-medical base closure and the older Vista trauma incidents are not new in this interval; Kula Hospital was a reopening plan, not a completed restoration. No qualifying October 25 access change established.
coverage_notes.exclusions: No newly effective service loss, government access-risk notice, or concretely effective essential-service restoration independently confirmed. Excluded speculative plans, opinion, business-only changes, duplicate/historical cases and unsupported claims.
coverage_notes.limitations: Sunday morning reporting/indexing delays and unindexed agency statements may hide real events. These are normal discoverability constraints, not an observed material search or tool failure. No claim of comprehensive national coverage.
coverage_notes.controls: Supplementary only. No approvals, publication, changes to schedule, or disablement.
